features.message: There's now a live rain radar animation on the Map. Data is from KNMI, for the last 45 minutes, in 15 minute steps.
Forecasts on the Point tab now include short-term, 5-minute resolution rain forecasts for the next 2 hours, using radar data from KNMI.
Several bugs were fixed and some tweaks were done to the UI as well, to improve usability.
